row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.evidence: Blackboard LMS administrator docs describe user provisioning only through SAML just-in-time provisioning and the SIS Framework (Snapshot Flat File, LIS 2.0, SIF, Enterprise 1.1); no SCIM endpoint appears in the admin docs, developer docs or the Learn REST API reference, and the Okta and Entra catalogue apps are SAML-only.
row.notes: Status changed from June 'gated' to 'none' (by absence, confidence medium). June's claim that 'Blackboard provides SCIM URL + token' on enterprise deployments has no first-party source: no SCIM appears in the Blackboard LMS administrator docs table of contents, the docs.blackboard.com sitemap, or the Learn REST API swagger (no /scim paths), so it is dropped, as is the third-party 'GBP 65K-100K/yr' figure. Renamed: Blackboard is now an independent company that 'emerged from the Anthology restructuring in February 2026'; anthology.com product pages redirect to blackboard.com. No public pricing (Book a Demo / Contact Us). Provisioning paths: SAML JIT, SIS Framework feeds, and the Learn REST API (users CRUD with OAuth 2.0 entitlements).

plans.name: Blackboard LMS
plans.price_text: No public pricing (Book a Demo / Contact Us)

scim.notes: No SCIM documentation found; the vendor never says 'no', so available stays null and status is 'none' by absence.

auth.notes: Applications register on the developer portal for a key and secret; access is governed by Learn entitlements granted to the integration user. Tokens last one hour.

capabilities.notes: Deactivate/reactivate via availability.available; system roles via systemRoleIds on the user.

rate_limits.text: REST calls are subject to quotas and limits (developer groups, site quotas and rate limits); values not captured.

okta.notes: OIN page marks only SAML as checked (page markup).

entra.notes: Gallery tutorial covers SP-initiated SSO and JIT only; blackboard-learn-provisioning-tutorial returns 404.

fallbacks.other_sync: SIS Framework integrations: Snapshot Flat File, Snapshot XML, IMS LIS 2.0, SIF, IMS Enterprise 1.1
